run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with a config yaml to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a linear reference file to compute element-wise normalized statistics
create_element_references: create element references from a fitted linear reference file for energy normalization
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit normalizers on a training dataset using targets and batch size from config
save_normalizers_checkpoint: save fitted normalizers to a checkpoint file named normalizers.pt at the output path
